meanings.en: an unspecified or unknown person
meanings.exampleEn: Someone left their umbrella in the office.
meanings.exampleTr: Biri şemsiyesini ofiste bırakmış.

meanings.en: an unspecified or unknown thing
meanings.exampleEn: I need to tell you something important.
meanings.exampleTr: Sana önemli bir şey söylemem gerek.

meanings.en: comparative of soon; earlier than expected or than another time
meanings.exampleEn: We should have left sooner to avoid the traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Trafiğe yakalanmamak için daha erken çıkmalıydık.

meanings.en: a black powder produced when coal, wood, etc. is burned
meanings.exampleEn: The chimney was covered in a thick layer of soot.
meanings.exampleTr: Baca kalın bir kurum tabakasıyla kaplıydı.

meanings.en: past tense and past participle of seek; tried to find or obtain something
meanings.exampleEn: She sought advice from a financial expert.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir mali uzmandan tavsiye istedi.

meanings.en: wanted by many people and usually of high quality or rare
meanings.exampleEn: He is one of the most sought-after designers in the industry.
meanings.exampleTr: Sektördeki en çok aranan tasarımcılardan biridir.

meanings.en: a way or activity from which money is regularly earned
meanings.exampleEn: Renting out the apartment became her main source of income.
meanings.exampleTr: Daireyi kiraya vermek onun ana gelir kaynağı oldu.

meanings.en: having independent power and the right to govern itself
meanings.exampleEn: Each sovereign state has the right to make its own laws.
meanings.exampleTr: Her egemen devletin kendi yasalarını yapma hakkı vardır.

meanings.en: a king or queen; a supreme ruler
meanings.exampleEn: The sovereign addressed the nation on the anniversary.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümdar yıl dönümünde ulusa hitap etti.

meanings.en: having a lot of space; large in area
meanings.exampleEn: They moved into a spacious apartment with big windows.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük pencereli, ferah bir daireye taşındılar.

meanings.en: time when you are not working and can do what you want
meanings.exampleEn: In her spare time she enjoys painting and hiking.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş zamanında resim yapmaktan ve doğa yürüyüşünden hoşlanır.

meanings.tr: idareli, az miktarda, tutumlu bir şekilde
meanings.en: in small amounts or only when necessary
meanings.exampleEn: Use the spice sparingly, as it is very strong.
meanings.exampleTr: Baharatı idareli kullan, çünkü çok yoğun.

meanings.en: the quality of being thinly spread or small in amount
meanings.exampleEn: The sparseness of the data made analysis difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Verilerin seyrekliği analizi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: to speak more loudly so people can hear you
meanings.exampleEn: Could you speak up? I can't hear you at the back.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha yüksek sesle konuşabilir misin? Arkada seni duyamıyorum.

meanings.en: to express your opinion openly, especially about something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: She wasn't afraid to speak up against injustice.
meanings.exampleTr: Adaletsizliğe karşı sesini yükseltmekten korkmadı.

meanings.en: covered with small marks or spots
meanings.exampleEn: The bird laid speckled eggs in the nest.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuş yuvaya benekli yumurtalar bıraktı.

meanings.en: to move or happen faster, or to make something do so
meanings.exampleEn: We need to speed up the process to meet the deadline.
meanings.exampleTr: Teslim tarihine yetişmek için süreci hızlandırmamız gerekiyor.

meanings.en: the quality of having a strong, hot flavour from spices
meanings.exampleEn: The spiciness of the curry made my eyes water.
meanings.exampleTr: Köri­nin acılığı gözlerimi yaşarttı.

meanings.en: a tap or valve controlling the flow of liquid from a container or pipe
meanings.exampleEn: He turned the spigot to fill the bucket with water.
meanings.exampleTr: Kovayı suyla doldurmak için musluğu açtı.

meanings.en: to flow over the edge, or to spread beyond its original limits
meanings.exampleEn: The tensions in the region could spill over into open conflict.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgedeki gerginlikler açık bir çatışmaya sirayet edebilir.

meanings.tr: yan ürün, türev; bir şirketten ayrılan yeni şirket
meanings.en: a product, company or programme derived from an existing one
meanings.exampleEn: The new company was a spin-off from the university's research lab.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni şirket, üniversitenin araştırma laboratuvarından türeyen bir yan kuruluştu.

meanings.en: the row of bones down the middle of the back
meanings.exampleEn: She injured her spine in the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazada omurgasını yaraladı.

meanings.en: the narrow part of a book's cover where the pages are joined
meanings.exampleEn: The title was printed on the spine of the book.
meanings.exampleTr: Başlık kitabın sırtına basılmıştı.

meanings.en: deliberately wanting to hurt, annoy or upset someone
meanings.exampleEn: She made a spiteful remark about his appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun görünüşü hakkında kinci bir yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: magnificent and impressive beauty or grandeur
meanings.exampleEn: The palace was restored to its former splendour.
meanings.exampleTr: Saray eski görkemine kavuşturuldu.

meanings.en: to end a relationship or marriage
meanings.exampleEn: They split up after ten years together.
meanings.exampleTr: On yıl birlikte olduktan sonra ayrıldılar.

meanings.en: to divide into smaller groups or parts
meanings.exampleEn: Let's split up and search different parts of the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayrılıp binanın farklı bölümlerini arayalım.

meanings.en: used to describe a very severe headache
meanings.exampleEn: I had to lie down because of a splitting headache.
meanings.exampleTr: Çatlayan bir baş ağrısı yüzünden uzanmak zorunda kaldım.

meanings.en: to spend a lot of money on something, especially as a treat
meanings.exampleEn: We decided to splurge on a luxury hotel for the weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta sonu için lüks bir otele savurganca harcama yapmaya karar verdik.

meanings.en: the quality of doing things naturally, without planning
meanings.exampleEn: There was a lack of spontaneity in his carefully rehearsed speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Özenle prova edilmiş konuşmasında bir doğallık eksikliği vardı.

meanings.en: strange and frightening in a way that makes you feel nervous
meanings.exampleEn: The old house looked spooky in the moonlight.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski ev ay ışığında ürkütücü görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a cylinder on which thread, wire, film or tape is wound
meanings.exampleEn: She wound the thread carefully onto the spool.
meanings.exampleTr: İpliği dikkatlice makaraya sardı.

meanings.en: happening occasionally and irregularly, not regularly
meanings.exampleEn: There were sporadic outbreaks of violence during the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece boyunca düzensiz şiddet olayları yaşandı.

meanings.tr: ara sıra, düzensiz aralıklarla, seyrek olarak
meanings.en: occasionally or at irregular intervals
meanings.exampleEn: He attended the meetings only sporadically.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantılara yalnızca ara sıra katıldı.

meanings.en: a man who takes part in sport, especially professionally
meanings.exampleEn: He was voted sportsman of the year for his achievements.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarıları nedeniyle yılın sporcusu seçildi.

meanings.en: a woman who takes part in sport, especially professionally
meanings.exampleEn: She is regarded as the greatest sportswoman of her generation.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşağının en büyük kadın sporcusu olarak kabul ediliyor.

meanings.en: a small stem with leaves taken from a plant
meanings.exampleEn: Garnish the dish with a sprig of mint.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemeği bir dal naneyle süsleyin.

meanings.en: a wheel with teeth around the edge that connects with a chain
meanings.exampleEn: The bicycle chain slipped off the rear sprocket.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisiklet zinciri arka dişliden çıktı.

meanings.tr: (özellikle yaşlı biri için) çevik, dinç, canlı
meanings.en: active and energetic, especially for an older person
meanings.exampleEn: My grandmother is still spry at eighty-five.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannem seksen beş yaşında hâlâ dinç.

meanings.tr: ani ve şiddetli fırtına, bora, sağanak
meanings.en: a sudden strong wind, often with rain or snow
meanings.exampleEn: A sudden squall hit the boat and tore the sail.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani bir bora tekneyi vurdu ve yelkeni yırttı.

meanings.en: marked by sudden strong winds and rain
meanings.exampleEn: The forecast warned of squally weather along the coast.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava tahmini kıyı boyunca boralı hava konusunda uyardı.

meanings.tr: (para, zaman, fırsat) çarçur etmek, boşa harcamak
meanings.en: to waste money, time or opportunities carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: He squandered his inheritance on gambling.
meanings.exampleTr: Mirasını kumarda çarçur etti.

meanings.en: a person who wastes money, time or resources
meanings.exampleEn: He was known as a squanderer who never saved a penny.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiç para biriktirmeyen bir müsrif olarak tanınıyordu.

meanings.en: an adult male deer
meanings.exampleEn: A magnificent stag stood at the edge of the forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Görkemli bir erkek geyik ormanın kenarında duruyordu.

meanings.en: not developing, growing or changing; showing no activity
meanings.exampleEn: The economy has remained stagnant for several years.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomi birkaç yıldır durgun kaldı.

meanings.en: (of water) not flowing and often smelling unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: Mosquitoes bred in the stagnant water of the pond.
meanings.exampleTr: Sivrisinekler göletin durgun suyunda ürüyordu.

meanings.en: a situation in which neither side can win or make progress
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations reached a stalemate over pay.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler ücret konusunda bir çıkmaza girdi.

meanings.en: the state of being no longer fresh, new or interesting
meanings.exampleEn: The staleness of the bread made it inedible.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmeğin bayatlığı onu yenmez hale getirdi.

meanings.en: to rise to a standing position from sitting or lying
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone stood up when the judge entered the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Yargıç odaya girince herkes ayağa kalktı.

meanings.en: to defend or support someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You should stand up for your rights.
meanings.exampleTr: Haklarını savunmalısın.

meanings.en: the usual or fixed price of a product before any discount
meanings.exampleEn: The standard-price of the software is higher than the promotional offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımın standart fiyatı, promosyon teklifinden daha yüksek.
